headline: Approved a fall carnival at 100 Main Street and an auto repair shop at 102 Esten Avenue.
summary: Licenses approved included a fall carnival at 100 Main Street, a new auto repair shop at 102 Esten Avenue with four stipulations, a pigeon loft renewal, and a first class victualling house license at 250 Main Street. The applicant withdrew a cabaret and beer and wine event license at 560 Mineral Spring Avenue. The reading of the September 10, 2026 records was postponed to October 7, 2026.
decisions: Postponed the reading of the September 10, 2026 records to October 7, 2026, on a unanimous voice vote.
Approved the consent agenda on a unanimous voice vote.
Approved the renewal of a pigeon loft license for Petros Zervas at 27 Harrison St. on a unanimous voice vote.
Approved a first class victualling house license for The Bluejay Café at 250 Main Street on a unanimous voice vote.
Approved a fall carnival at 100 Main Street from October 8 to October 12, 2026, on a unanimous voice vote.
Approved a new auto repair shop license for Correia Auto Repair at 102 Esten Avenue, with four stipulations, on a unanimous voice vote.
Read and ordered filed a communication from David Sackal of CoLab Studio Theatre requesting withdrawal of its application.
Withdrew the CoLab Studio Theatre petition for a cabaret event and beer and wine sales at 560 Mineral Spring Avenue, at the applicant's request, on a unanimous voice vote.

376 
Pawtucket Board of License Commissioners 
September 23, 2026 
 
A regular session of the Pawtucket Board of License Commissioners was held Wednesday, 
September 23, 2026, at 7:20 p.m., in the Temporary City Council Chambers, 2nd floor, 100 
Freight Street, Pawtucket, RI. 
 
Present – President Mercer; Councilors Araujo, Coderre, Gregor, Moran, Moreno, Rubio and 
Wildenhain. 
 
Absent – Councilor Stachowiak. 
 
Chairperson Mercer presided.  
 
The reading of the records of September 10, 2026 was POSTPONED until the m eeting on 
October 7, 2026, on a unanimous voice vote. 
 
 
Upon motion made by Councilor Araujo, seconded by Councilor  Moreno, the *Consent 
Agenda was APPROVED, on a unanimous voice vote. 
 
*THE FOLLOWING PETITIONS FOR LICENSES WERE APPROVED ON A 
UNANIMOUS VOICE VOTE: 
 
PIGEON LOFT Renewal -  
 
Zervas, Petros, 27 Harrison St. LIC#PGN-24-1 
 
VICTUALLING HOUSE First Class New – 
 
The Bluejay Café (The Bluejay Café LLC) 250 Main Street, LIC#VIC-26-21 
 
 
A PUBLIC HEARING ON THE FOLLOWING APPLICATION FOR A LICENSE, WHICH  
WAS ADVERTISED FOR A HEARING AT THIS TIME, WAS TAKEN UP: 
 
CARNIVAL -  
 
Petition of Rockwell Amusement and Promotions, Inc., to have a Fall Carnival at 100 Main 
Street on Thursday, October 8, 2026, from 6:00 p.m. until 10:00 p.m.; Friday, October 9, 
2026, from 6:00 pm until 10:00 p.m.; Saturday, October 10, 2026, from 2:00 p.m. until 10:00 
p.m.; Sunday, October 11, 2026, from 2:00 p.m. until 10:00 p.m., and Monday, October 12, 
2026, from 2:00 p.m. until 8:00 p.m. LIC#EVT -26-83 (Charity: Pawtucket Soup Kitch en 
located at 150 Walcott Street) 
 
Speaking in favor was Harold Fera, 10 Red Oak Drive, Johnston, RI, applicant. 
 
Mr. Fera stated that the carnival will be the same as the one last year.   The area will be 
cleaned up both before and after th e event.   The ca rnival is inspected by State and City 
inspectors prior to the event.  
 
There were no other speakers. The hearing was closed. 
 
THE CHAIR RECOGNIZED COUNCILOR CODERRE. 
 
Upon motion made by Councilor Coderre, seconded by Councilor Moran, the following 
petition for license was APPROVED, on a unanimous voice vote: 
 
CARNIVAL -  
 
Petition of Rockwell Amusement and Promotions, Inc., to have a Fall Carnival at 100 Main 
Street on Thursday, October 8, 2026, from 6:00 p.m. until 10:00 p.m.; Friday, October 9, 
2026, from 6:00 pm until 10:00 p.m.; Saturday, October 10, 2026, from 2:00 p.m. until 10:00 
p.m.; Sunday, October 11, 2026, from 2:00 p.m. until 10:00 p.m., and Monday, October 12, 
2026, from 2:00 p.m. until 8:00 p.m. LIC#EVT -26-83 (Charity: Pawtucket Soup Kitchen 
located at 150 Walcott Street)
377 
Pawtucket Board of License Commissioners 
September 23, 2026 
 
THE FOLLOWING PUBLIC HEARING AND PETITION FOR LICENSE W ERE 
POSTPONED AT THE MEETINGS HELD AUGUST 5, 2026, AND SEPTEMBER 10, 
2026, AND WERE AGAIN TAKEN UP: 
 
AUTO REPAIR SHOP New – 
 
Correia Auto Repair (Professional Auto Repair LLC) 102 Esten Avenue, LIC#AUT-26-8® 
(Prev. Woodlawn Village) 
 
Speaking was Danielson Correia, 62 Laura Street, Providence, RI, the applicant. 
 
Mr. Correia stated that the hours of operation  will be from 9:30 a.m. to 6:00 p.m.  He stated 
that most of the work will be performed indoors, with some small jobs conducted outside.   He  
questioned the business address, stating that it should be listed as 64 Woodlawn Avenue. 
 
There were no other speakers. The hearing was closed. 
 
THE CHAIR RECOGNIZED COUNCILOR GREGOR. 
 
Upon motion made by Councilor Gregor, seconded by Councilor Moreno, the following 
petition for license was APPROVED, with the following stipulations, on a unanimous voice 
vote: 
 
AUTO REPAIR SHOP New – 
 
Correia Auto Repair (Professional Auto Repair LLC) 102 Esten Avenue, LIC#AUT-26-8® 
(Prev. Woodlawn Village) 
Stipulations: 
1. The hours of operation will be from 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. 
2. All work must be performed indoors. 
3. No vehicles may be parked on the street. 
4. No junk vehicles may be used for parts. 
 
 
THE CHAIR RECOGNIZED COUNCILOR ARAUJO. 
 
Upon motion made by Councilor Araujo, seconded by Councilor Moran, the agenda was 
amended to include the following communication, on a unanimous voice vote: 
 
Communication from David Sackal, President and Executive Director of Colab Studio 
Theatre, to Michelle Hardy, Deputy City Clerk, re questing the withdrawal of the application 
for the event. 
 
Upon motion made by Councilor Araujo, seconded by Councilor Cod erre, the following 
communication was READ AND ORDERED FILED: 
 
Communication from David Sackal, President and Executive Director of Colab Studio 
Theatre, to Michelle Hardy, Deputy City Clerk, re questing the withdrawal of the application 
for the event. 
 
THE FOLLOWING PETITION FOR LICENSE  WAS WITHDRAWN AT THE REQUEST 
OF THE  APPLICANT ON A UNANIMOUS VOICE VOTE: 
 
ENTERTAINMENT & CLASS F (Beer & Wine) –  
 
Petition of CoLab Studio Theatre Inc., for a license to conduct a Fundraiser and to have a 
Cabaret Singing Event at 560 Mineral Spring Avenue, Unit 1 -103, and to sell beer & wine on 
Friday, October 16, and Saturday, October 17, 2026, from 7:00 p.m. until 9:00 p.m. 
LIC#EVT-26-85 
 
Upon motion made by Councilor Araujo, seconded by Councilor Coderre, the meeting 
was adjourned at 7:48 p.m.
